name: Brizy
summary: Drag-and-drop website builder with an AI builder, hosted on Brizy Cloud or as a WordPress plugin, with multi-site agency plans and a white-label version for resellers.
best_for: freelancers and agencies that build several client websites and want hosting included, with a white-label option to resell the builder under their own brand
skip_if: you need one simple site at the lowest price, you want full code-level design control, or you mainly sell products online
honest_knock: Personal covers one website and each extra site costs $17 a month. E-commerce sites are priced separately under Brizy Shops, and the WordPress plugin has its own pricing, so the Cloud prices are not the whole picture. Our own test on 5 November 2026 stayed on the free Cloud trial, where the AI request was blocked; paid plans were not part of it. Brizy's terms (last updated 7 October 2026) narrow the money-back promise on the pricing page: the 30-day refund covers new monthly or yearly subscriptions only, not renewals, lifetime licences, add-ons or anything bought outside brizy.io, and auto-renewal has to be switched off at least 24 hours before the renewal date. The terms are governed by the laws of the United Kingdom, with an arbitration clause you can opt out of by email within 30 days.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Personal (Cloud) · billed monthly, 1 website, hosting included
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-09 in a browser render of brizy.io/pricing-cloud, USD, both billing toggles; taxes not included) Brizy Cloud is the hosted version. Personal is $19 a month or $190 a year for 1 website, with each additional site at $17 a month, 1 workspace and unlimited team members. Agency is $69 a month or $690 a year for 10 websites, additional sites $12 a month, 10 workspaces and priority email support. White Label is $159 a month or $1,590 a year for 10 websites, additional sites $8 a month, client management, the builder under your own brand and client billing through Stripe. Enterprise is quoted and adds on-premises hosting, API and SSO access and tiered volume pricing. All Cloud plans include the AI builder and hosting on AWS with unlimited visits and storage, and there is a 14-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee. E-commerce sites are priced separately under Brizy Shops, and the WordPress plugin has its own pricing; neither was read. Re-read on 24 October 2026 with a plain fetch of brizy.io/pricing-cloud: all Cloud prices, site allowances and per-site extras unchanged. The billing toggle is labelled 'Yearly -20%', but the yearly prices work out at about 17% below twelve monthly payments: $190 against $228 on Personal, $690 against $828 on Agency and $1,590 against $1,908 on White Label. Brizy Shops, read the same day on brizy.io/pricing-cloud-shops, is a store add-on billed on top of a Cloud plan: Venture $20 a month (100 products plus digital goods, or $200 a year), Business $45 (2,500 products, marketplaces, subscriptions, abandoned-cart recovery, a multilingual store) and Unlimited $100 (unlimited products, point-of-sale integration), with 0% transaction fees from Brizy and a 14-day trial during which store visitors cannot place orders.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 5 November 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We went through sign-up, opened the Cloud editor and sent our test prompt to the built-in AI assistant. The request was blocked, so no page was built. We did not publish, export or open checkout.
findings: Sign-up asks four required survey questions (business type, company size, role, how you found Brizy), then shows a member dashboard with 'Start free trial Cloud'. No card was requested.
The trial banner read 'Your trial ends in 14 days! Upgrade to publish your website.' The new project card was labelled PRO PROJECT.
'Create New Website' offers four starting methods: From Scratch, Start with a template, Generate with AI 1.9 and Generate with AI 2.0 (Beta).

Our first prompt in the AI panel ended in 'Out of AI credits - AI credits limit reached', with top-ups of $10, $25 and $50 on offer, plus 'Couldn't finish your request'. The plan cards say 'AI Builder Included', so the trial's AI allowance is unclear.

The plan page had Yearly -20% preselected: Personal $19/mo (1 website), Agency $69/mo (10 websites), White Label $159/mo and a custom Enterprise plan with API access and SSO. We did not look at monthly prices.
not_tested: A completed AI or manual page, and Save Draft: the AI request was blocked and we did not build by hand
Export, re-import, roles, API settings, downgrade and cancellation
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
